reason: Primary purpose is an AI-assisted design workflow plugin for the DeepSeek Harness: it adds a persistent Design Studio UI, a live design preview route, an element-picker edit flow, and a design_studio agent tool for managing mockup files in temp_design_folder, with optional OpenRouter-powered vision review. This indicates the plugin’s main user-facing value is orchestrating design edits and verification, not general code generation or broad repository tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在对话中提供持久化的 Design Studio 标签页与实时预览，支持元素选取、设计文件管理，并结合 DeepSeek 与设计代理完成修改与校验。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides a persistent Design Studio experience with live preview, enabling design-file management and element-based edits through coordinated AI flows with DeepSeek and a design agent.

capabilities: Exposes a design_studio toolset that performs design-system management and file operations such as list/create/read/write/zip/reveal/delete within a configured workspace folder.
Provides a web UI workflow (Design Studio tab, element picker, live preview, settings) for AI-guided UI design iteration.
Supports image handling through uploads/drops, screenshot capture into design assets, and image-based prompt flow.
Invokes AI/vision workflows via an external service path (OpenRouter) for image description and review.
